faqs.question: How long does a typical AI Chatbot Development engagement take?
faqs.answer: Most chatbot projects launch in 4–10 weeks: discovery, conversation design, integrations, testing, and go-live. Complex multi-channel bots may take longer.

faqs.question: Do you work with existing teams and tools?
faqs.answer: Yes. We integrate with websites, WhatsApp, helpdesks, CRMs, and your content systems, and we train your team to iterate intents and responses.

faqs.question: How do you measure success?
faqs.answer: We track containment rate, CSAT, first-response time, lead capture quality, and escalation quality — not vanity chat volume.

faqs.question: Website, WhatsApp, or both?
faqs.answer: Both. We design channel-aware flows so tone, latency, and handoff fit web widgets and WhatsApp Business without duplicating messy logic.

faqs.question: Will the bot sound on-brand?
faqs.answer: Yes. We write conversation UX against your brand voice, with guardrails, fallbacks, and approved knowledge sources — not generic LLM filler.

faqs.question: Can it capture and qualify leads?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Bots can ask discovery questions, score intent, book calls, and sync qualified leads into your CRM with source attribution.

faqs.question: What happens when the bot is unsure?
faqs.answer: Clear fallbacks, clarification prompts, and one-tap human handoff with full transcript context so customers never feel stuck.

faqs.question: Do you support multilingual bots?
faqs.answer: Yes, where content and moderation are ready. We prioritize languages that matter to your audience and keep quality bar high before expanding.

faqs.question: How do we get started?
faqs.answer: Send your top FAQs and channels. We propose a pilot scope (usually one primary journey), then expand after proving containment and conversion.

faqs.question: Who will maintain the bot after launch?
faqs.answer: Your team can update content, or we can retain for content ops, analytics reviews, and model/prompt improvements.
